messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT: High error-rate on /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1 (p95 latency spike). Trigger: 502_ratio > 10% for 5m. Pager: @alex, @oncall-l2. Auto-bridge created: https://zoom.company/bridge/1888881234 :rotating_light:

alex: Got the page, I'm on it. Jumping into logs now. Creating bridge.

maria: On the bridge. I can see a surge of 502s from model-serving instances behind router-12. Appears to coincide with a spike in long-sequence requests.

alex: Noted. Rolling back last routing change (traffic-weight bump to quantized-llama-v2) to see if that helps. Running: `rctl routes update --service generate --weights default:100`

sre-bot: Rollback executed by alex at 2026-08-21T01:12Z. Previous weights restored.

maria: After rollback, 502 rate dropped to ~3%. p95 latency still elevated ~1.6s but trending down. Likely a mismatch between kernel selection for quantized variant and longer contexts.

jonathan: Priya looping in customer success — we have a few customers on S1 with active sessions. Priya can you assess exposure?

priya: On it. Reached out to top 3 affected customers. Two reported degraded responses, one reported brief disconnects. Customers are on a dev feature flag; no financial impact reported yet. Scheduling a follow-up email.

lisa: Support ticket numbers: #CS-9021, #CS-9023. Adding to incident notes.

alex: Good catch. Let's keep mitigation: keep quantized variant out of rotation. Also enable additional autoscale for host-pool inference-12 to reduce queue growth. Command: `infra autoscale set inference-12 --min 4 --max 16`

maria: Autoscale hit, new instances started. Metrics show queue backlog clearing.

sre-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 by alex. Handoff planned in 30m to oncall-l2.

oncall-l2: I'm taking the handoff at 02:00Z. Can someone summarize actionable items for the post-incident?

alex: Summary for handoff: 1) Keep quantized-llama-v2 off default route. 2) Watch p95 latency and 502 ratio for next 2h. 3) Produce short RCA draft and schedule postmortem meeting within 72 hours. 4) Draft status page update for customers.

maria: Also collect kernel logs and recent compile artifacts for quantized-llama-v2. Suspect a kernel path selection bug for sequences > 2k tokens. Example logs:```
E 01:10:42 kernel_select: mismatch arch: fallback path used
W 01:11:00 kvcache: eviction spikes
```

jonathan: For communications: propose internal RCA doc then a customer-friendly RCA with timeline and mitigation. I can draft the customer note once we have timeline and action items.

priya: I'll prepare a short email for impacted customers summarizing: what happened, who was affected, what we did, and next steps. ETA for draft: 4 hours.

lisa: I'll queue the support replies and tag customers with the temporary mitigation (quantized model disabled).

alex: Action items assigned now:
- alex: follow up with runtime team for kernel selection patch and prioritize a fix (owner: alex).
- maria: gather logs, compile artifact hashes, and upload to incident repo (owner: maria).
- jonathan: prepare customer-facing RCA draft (owner: jonathan).
- priya: send initial customer outreach and coordinate bridge for any customer calls (owner: priya).
- lisa: update support tickets and add status page note (owner: lisa).

sre-bot: Action items logged in incident tracker: INC-188888. Link: https://tracker.company/inc/188888

maria: For the postmortem, propose these topics: timeline, root cause hypothesis (kernel selection + long-context regression), replication steps, remediation plan (fix compile path + add e2e for long sequences), and follow-ups (QA coverage + canary plan).

alex: Agreed. Schedule: Postmortem meeting in 48 hours so infra and runtime can attend. Can someone set the calendar?

jonathan: Calendar invite sent for 48h from now, 30min slot, with meeting doc attached.

priya: Customer comms plan: short status page update now (we did mitigation) + a full RCA to be posted once validated (within 5 business days). I recommend offering a direct sync to any enterprise customers who request it.

lisa: Draft of status page note: "We experienced elevated error rates for generate endpoints between 01:05Z and 01:30Z in us-east-1. Mitigation: removed a model variant from rotation and autoscaled serving pool. No lasting data loss. We will publish an RCA after investigation." Thoughts?

alex: Good. Add timeframe and a link to incident tracker. Keep it short. :+1:

maria: One more item: add automated regression tests for sequence lengths > 2k in the compilation pipeline. I'll create a ticket.

sre-bot: Oncall handoff complete. Owner: oncall-l2. Reminder: maintain watch for 2h and escalate if 502_ratio > 5% persists.

oncall-l2: Taking watch. Will post a 30m check-in in thread.

priya: Quick note for customer messaging: avoid technical jargon about kernel selection; keep it to model routing and mitigation for the public note. Save technical details for the deep RCA.

alex: Agreed. Also, we should include a short apology and next steps for trust restoration: timeline for fix and offer a direct point of contact.

jonathan: Draft customer line: "We removed an experimental model variant from traffic and increased capacity to restore service. We're investigating the root cause and will share a detailed RCA in the coming days."

lisa: I'll publish the status page update now and link the incident tracker. Published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/188888 — pinging #marketing for amplification.

maria: Uploading artifacts to incident repo now.

alex: Thanks everyone. Good mitigation and fast handoff. We'll reconvene in the postmortem.

oncall-l2: 30m check-in: metrics stable, 502s <2%, p95 latency ~1.1s. Continuing watch.

sre-bot: Incident resolved and downgraded to monitoring. Final note: ensure action items completed before postmortem closes.

alex: Closing loop — we'll track items in INC-188888 and follow up in the postmortem doc.

priya: I'll send an interim note to impacted customers summarizing mitigation and when they can expect the RCA. Draft sent to #customer-success for review. :email:

jonathan: Posting postmortem doc link here once live.

maria: Reminder to include regression test and canary rollout plan as action items.

lisa: Support tickets updated and customers notified.

sre-bot: Locking thread. If further action required, reply with `reopen` to unlock."
